en.title: Jeremy Renner Jokingly Blames Hawkeye's Absence for Potential Avengers: Doomsday Loss
en.summary: Jeremy Renner has humorously declared that the Avengers might face defeat in the upcoming 'Avengers: Doomsday.' His reasoning? He wasn't invited to join the fray as Hawkeye.
en.body:
The Marvel Cinematic Universe is gearing up for its next monumental crossover event, **Avengers: Doomsday**, and while the full roster remains under wraps, one prominent Avenger has made it clear he won't be suiting up. **Jeremy Renner**, the sharp-shooting **Hawkeye**, has playfully suggested that the Earth's Mightiest Heroes are doomed without him.

When asked about his involvement in **Avengers: Doomsday**, Renner responded with a definitive "No, no, no, no. Not in that one." He then elaborated on his absence, adding a touch of his signature dry wit. "Doomsday I'm not in, so The Avengers will probably lose, just so you know… they didn’t call me so it’s their fault they’re going to lose." This playful jab, widely reported across entertainment news outlets, implies that the strategic prowess and unparalleled archery skills of **Hawkeye** are indispensable, even in the face of cosmic threats.

## The Unseen Impact of the Archer

While **Hawkeye** may not possess the god-like powers of some of his teammates, **Clint Barton** has consistently proven his worth. From his early days in **The Avengers** to his more recent solo adventures, he's offered a grounded, human perspective and a tactical mind that has often saved the day. His absence in a film titled **Doomsday**—a name that suggests an existential threat—certainly leaves a void. Renner's comments tap into a sentiment shared by many fans: that every Avenger, no matter how seemingly ordinary, plays a crucial role in the team's success. The idea that the entire team might falter because **Hawkeye** wasn't given a call is a testament to the character's enduring appeal and the unique contributions he brings.

## What the Fans Are Saying

Renner's lighthearted remarks have, predictably, sparked a flurry of reactions within the dedicated MCU fanbase. On social media platforms and fan forums, discussions are rife with speculation about the potential challenges the Avengers might face without their master archer. Many fans echo Renner's sentiment, humorously lamenting the team's presumed disadvantage. Others see it as a testament to **Hawkeye**'s importance, reinforcing his status as a fan-favorite despite often being overshadowed by more powerful heroes. The playful banter highlights the deep connection fans have with these characters and their unwavering belief in the collective strength of the Avengers, even when one key member is absent.

## What's Next

Details surrounding the plot and full cast of **Avengers: Doomsday** are still scarce, with Marvel Studios maintaining its characteristic secrecy. Fans will have to wait for official announcements to confirm which heroes will indeed assemble for this next chapter in the saga. In the meantime, **Jeremy Renner** continues to be a beloved figure in the MCU, and his witty commentary only adds to the anticipation for future installments.
